## Standing operator rules
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.”
- “Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.”
- Sandbox payments moved to `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use `sbx-pay-c`.
- Raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 is forbidden because it caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` sending reminders to already-paid customers. Router split is superseded/paused; onboarding is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Acme: `org_acme_industries`, `REQ-2025-01842`, `enterprise-annual`, USD. `current_request_id`; invoice page size 25. `sbx-pay-c` supersedes `sbx-pay-a`.

## Ruled-out approaches
SQLAlchemy pool size 50: staging lock contention and deadlocks.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Validate request and seed Acme.
- [pending] Inspect scheduler: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`
- [pending] Add paid-invoice regression, fix, run focused tests.
- [pending] Resume router split with small commits.

## Recent work
Scheduler recurrence DST fix and tests pass; focused billing tests pass. Full suite: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated legacy-rounding failure. Added `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`; 6 focused cases pass, including default precision and high-precision rounding.
